text: decent start uh i am not a fan at all of where this input is though. give me a hotkey and when pressed open a popover and let me type there. this bar you put it in is not the place because there is far too much going on up there already
resolution: Moved GUI semantic naming off the action bar and onto a hotkey + popover, as ruled. The action-bar input and tag button are gone; naming is now the mesh-name-faces command bound to N in face mode (contextual exactly like B/M/X — Free Brush keeps N while painting), also reachable from Edit > Mesh > Name Faces... and the context menu. It opens a blocking dialog built on the existing ScaleByDialog pattern: autofocused input, Enter commits, Escape cancels through AppFrame's blocking-overlay gate, plus chips listing the live semantic table's existing names so reusing a name extends that region rather than minting a near-duplicate. The apply now runs through withNativeMeshActionSource in AppFrame so journal provenance follows the true invocation source (hotkey/menu/context) instead of being hard-stamped 'toolbar' in the viewer. NOT VERIFIED LIVE: the dev host's JS push is blocked because the running binary's native build id (082743ea) no longer matches the disk framework fingerprint (c78c4cf7), so watch-and-push refuses and the live editor still lacks the command; the bundle itself rebuilt cleanly with every change in it. Needs a dev host rebuild — deliberately not started during the user's live editing session.
